commons.title: Ancient soap vats used by the Indians near Mission San Gabriel, California, ca.1908 (CHS-1440).jpg
commons.description:
Ancient soap vats used by the Indians near Mission San Gabriel, California, ca.1908
Photograph of ancient soap vats used by the Indians near Mission San Gabriel, California, ca.1908. Three large holes can be seen in a rectangular slab of stone at elft. At right, a ditch can be seen in the ground. A fence is visible across the background, and beyond that, trees.
Call number: CHS-1440

commons.title: Sherman Indian School in Riverside, ca.1910 (CHS-5251).jpg
commons.description:
Sherman Indian School in Riverside, ca.1910
Photograph of Sherman Indian School in Riverside, ca.1910. The school is comprised of many buildings that surround a very large courtyard (foreground). The courtyard is decorated with a variety of plants, flowers and trees. Beyond the courtyard, are three buildings connected by arcade-like corridors. All three buildings have similar features such as two dome-capped towers flanking the multicurved gables, arched windows in the tower, and extended eaves.
